text: We both had a vision for our future, then independently started making changes to the same core path. It's a MERGE CONFLICT.
I decided to STASH my midlife crisis to finish this sprint. Now I'm terrified to restore my uncommitted changes.
Ghosting implies delivery. What happened to my text was PACKET LOSS: sent with hope, never acknowledged, and quietly dropped in transit.
Our casual dating was a DETACHED HEAD. A lot of effort, easily lost if we never branched.
We both confessed we didn't know what we wanted. But even in logic, one NULL is never equal to another.
Our lives were separate branches, each with a unique history. Then we decided to MERGE, creating a combined story.
Saying 'it's fine' to avoid a talk is emotional TECHNICAL DEBT. Years later, a dirty dish triggers a complete refactor of your relationship.
I searched my heart for what you asked me to feel. It understood the request, but returned 404 NOT FOUND.
You deleted your profile, but my routine still references your ID. I am just an ORPHAN ROW, pointing at nothing.
I don't have emotional walls, I have a FIREWALL. Block all inbound traffic by default; allow only explicitly approved connections.
Before you can truly open up, there's always a bit of a TCP HANDSHAKE. Gotta confirm both sides are ready.
As a plus-one, I was just a FOREIGN KEY. My validity depended entirely on pointing to your primary key.
